dialogue.content: こんにちは時間になるまでもう少しお待ちください。今日はよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Hello, please wait a little longer until our session starts. I look forward to speaking with you today.

dialogue.content: (こんにちは こちらこそ宜しくお願い致します）
dialogue.English: (Hello, I look forward to it as well.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。初めに性別、年齢を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your gender and age?

dialogue.content: こんにちは　15歳女性です
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm a 15-year-old female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくんです
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: 行きたくないのです
dialogue.English: I mean, I don't want to go.

dialogue.content: そうですか、学校に行きたくないのですね。何か嫌なことがあったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see, so you don't want to go to school. Did something unpleasant happen?

dialogue.content: 嫌な事があったというか楽しくないの
dialogue.English: It’s not so much that something bad happened; it’s just not enjoyable.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ。学校に行っても楽しいことがないと思っているんだね。それは行きたくないよね
dialogue.English: I see. You feel that even if you go to school, there's nothing enjoyable for you there. That would make you not want to go, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: はき
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 中学三年生だと思うけど、いつ頃からそういう気持ちだったのかな？
dialogue.English: I believe you're in your third year of junior high. Since when have you been feeling this way?

dialogue.content: 3年になってから
dialogue.English: Since I started the third year.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ、新学年になってからなんだね。何がきっかけか、思うことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see, so it's been since the new school year started. Do you have any thoughts about what might have triggered it?

dialogue.content: 仲の良い友達と離れてしまってなんか気づいたらまわりはグループが出来ちゃっててなんかクラスに行きづらくなっちゃった
dialogue.English: I got separated from my close friends, and before I knew it, everyone around me had formed groups, so it became hard to go to class.

dialogue.content: そうだったの。　それは辛かったね。お友達と離れてショックを受けてる間に新しいグループが出来ちゃっていた。。。それは戸惑うよね。
dialogue.English: Oh, that's what happened. That must have been tough. While you were still shocked from being separated from your friends, new groups had already formed... That would be confusing.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: そうだったんだね。確かにどう新しいグループに入ろうかわからなくなるよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It makes sense that you wouldn't know how to join a new group.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 今はそれでも学校に頑張って行っているのかな？
dialogue.English: Are you still managing to go to school despite that?

dialogue.content: 一応行ってる
dialogue.English: I go, kind of.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ、それでもちゃんと頑張っているんだね。今は学校でどうやって過ごしているのかな？
dialogue.English: I see—you’re doing your best despite that. How do you spend your time at school now?

dialogue.content: 休み時間とか他のクラスに行ったりしてる
dialogue.English: During breaks and such, I go to other classrooms.

dialogue.content: そうだね！クラスの中にまだ友達はいないけど、隣に行けばたくさんいるもんね。
dialogue.English: That makes sense! You may not have friends in your class yet, but you have plenty in the next classroom over.

dialogue.content: たくさんではないけど…
dialogue.English: Not that many, though...

dialogue.content: 確かに。たくさん友達がいればいいというわけではないもんね。
dialogue.English: That's true. It's not about having a lot of friends.

dialogue.content: うん1、2年は前から仲のいい子と一緒だったから。
dialogue.English: Yeah, for my first and second years, I was with my good friends.

dialogue.content: 今はその子のクラスに行ってる
dialogue.English: So now I go to their classroom.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、心強いね。同じクラスに友達がいないと具体的にどんなことが嫌だなって思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see, that's reassuring. Specifically, what bothers you about not having friends in your class?

dialogue.content: まわりの目がきになるしクラス移動とか
dialogue.English: I feel like people are watching me, and things like moving between classes...

dialogue.content: なるほど。給食の時間や放課後は隣に行けばいいけどクラス移動が一人だと寂しいと思われると感じちゃうのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. So you can go to the other classroom during lunch and after school, but when you have to move between classes alone, you feel like people will think you're lonely?

dialogue.content: そうかな…後はずっと隣のクラスに行ってるのもクラスに、友達いないって思われるし
dialogue.English: I guess so... Also, if I'm always going to the classroom next door, people will think I don't have any friends in my own class.

dialogue.content: なるほどなるほど、そう思ってしまうんだね。今のクラスの中で、一人で移動している人とかは他にいない感じ？
dialogue.English: I see, I see, that's how you feel. In your current class, are there no other students who move between classes by themselves?

dialogue.content: 2人くらいはいると思うけど…
dialogue.English: I think there are about two others, but...

dialogue.content: 全然話した事ない子なんだよね…
dialogue.English: But they're kids I've never talked to...

dialogue.content: そっか。二人くらいは一人でいる子がいるんだね。やっぱそういう人を見ると、寂しそうだなって思う？
dialogue.English: I see. So there are a couple of other students who are by themselves. When you see them, do you think they look lonely?

dialogue.content: 思っちゃう。
dialogue.English: I do.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。その子たちには、話しかけてみたことはないの？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you ever tried talking to them?

dialogue.content: ないかな…本とか読んでるし
dialogue.English: I don't think so... They're usually reading books and stuff.

dialogue.content: なるほど、いつも本読んでるんだ。確かに話しかけにくいね。
dialogue.English: I see, they're always reading. That certainly does make them hard to approach.

dialogue.content: そう超真面目な感じなんだよね…
dialogue.English: Yeah, they seem super serious...

dialogue.content: 真面目な感じなんだ。でももしかしたら移動の時は流石に本読んでたら危ないから、ちょっと話しかけてみたら話してくれそうな気がするんだけど。
dialogue.English: They seem serious. But maybe when you're moving between classes, since it would be dangerous to read a book then, I feel like they might talk to you if you tried to strike up a conversation.

dialogue.content: そうだね…
dialogue.English: I guess so...

dialogue.content: そこまでして仲良くなりたいとは思わないのかな？想像してみてどう？
dialogue.English: Do you not feel like going that far to become friends? What do you think when you imagine it?

dialogue.content: うん…合わなかったらどうしようとか思って
dialogue.English: Yeah... I worry about what would happen if we don't get along.

dialogue.content: 迷惑じゃないかな…
dialogue.English: I wonder if I'd be a bother...

dialogue.content: そうかあ。迷惑かなって思っちゃうんだね。一人でいるし、一人が好きなんじゃないかって思っちゃうよね。わかるわかる。でもTOM Oさんみたいに、けして一人でいたいわけじゃなく、同じように仲良くなるタイミングを逃しちゃって一人で仕方なくいるかもしれないかも。。。
dialogue.English: I see. You worry you might be a bother. Since they're alone, you might think they like being alone. I completely understand. But just like you, TOMO, maybe they don't necessarily want to be alone, but they just missed the chance to make friends and have no choice but to be by themselves...

dialogue.content: そうか…たしかに。
dialogue.English: I see... That's true.

dialogue.content: TOMOさんがそうだったように、同じような理由で一人になってしまった子もいるような気がするんだけどね。そして話しかけられて迷惑って思う子って少ないと思うんだけどな。TOMOさんは突然知らない人に話しかけられるといや？
dialogue.English: Just like it happened to you, TOMO, I feel like there might be other kids who ended up alone for similar reasons. And I don't think many people would find it bothersome if someone started talking to them. TOMO, would you dislike it if a stranger suddenly started talking to you?

dialogue.content: イヤではないけど…
dialogue.English: I wouldn't dislike it, but...

dialogue.content: けど？
dialogue.English: But?

dialogue.content: 移動の時に話しかければいいのかな
dialogue.English: Maybe I should try talking to them when we're moving between classes?

dialogue.content: いいね！私もそのタイミングがいいような気がするよ。
dialogue.English: That's a great idea! I think that would be the perfect time too.

dialogue.content: そつだよね。
dialogue.English: Yeah, that makes sense.

dialogue.content: やってみる
dialogue.English: I’ll give it a try.

dialogue.content: いいね！きっと話しかけてくれて嬉しいと思うよ、顔には出さなくても
dialogue.English: Great! I'm sure they'll be happy you talked to them, even if it doesn't show on their face.

dialogue.content: 顔にはださなくても？
dialogue.English: Even if it doesn't show on their face?

dialogue.content: もし顔では特に嬉しそうに見えなかったとしても、心の中では、TOMOさんが話しかけてくれてうれしいと思うって意味。わかりにくくてごめんね。
dialogue.English: I mean that even if they don't look particularly happy on the outside, inside they'll feel happy that you talked to them, TOMO. Sorry if that was confusing.

dialogue.content: そっか。頑張ってみる
dialogue.English: Oh, okay. I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: なんかね、相談員のわたしが中学生の時、うれしいのになかなか表現できなかったタイプなので、そう書いてしまったのです。
dialogue.English: You know, when I was in junior high, I was the type of person who had a hard time showing it when I was happy, so that's why I wrote that.

dialogue.content: そうなんだあ。
dialogue.English: Oh, really?

dialogue.content: うんうん、頑張ってみて。行動してみることってすごく素敵なことだと思うよ
dialogue.English: Yes, give it a try. I think it's a wonderful thing to take action.

dialogue.content: うん。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: いつも応援してるからね。また困ったことがあればいつでも相談にきてね。よかったらまた来週くらいにどうなったか教えてほしいな。
dialogue.English: I'll always be cheering for you. If you run into any more trouble, feel free to come and talk anytime. If you'd like, I'd love to hear how it went sometime next week.

dialogue.content: わかった。どうなったかまた連絡します
dialogue.English: Okay. I'll let you know how it goes.

dialogue.content: うん、またお話しできるのを楽しみにしていますね。
dialogue.English: Okay, I look forward to speaking with you again.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、相談してくれてありがとう。また話そうね。
dialogue.English: No, thank you for sharing this with me. Let's talk again.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます♪
dialogue.English: Thank you! ♪

dialogue.content: （今日は時間ですのでここまでとなります。どうもありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (That's all the time we have for today. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそありがとうございました。誤字がおおくてすみませんでした)
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. I'm sorry for all the typos.)

dialogue.content: （とんでもないです。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Not at all. Thank you.)
